units.1 Chronicles 17:1: When David was dwelling in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I dwell in a cedar house, but the ark of the Lord’s covenant is beneath skins.”
units.1 Chronicles 17:2: Nathan said to David, “Do everything in your soul, for God is with you.”
units.1 Chronicles 17:3: That night the Lord’s word came to Nathan, saying,
units.1 Chronicles 17:4: “Go and say to David My servant, ‘Thus says the Lord: You shall not build Me a house for Me to dwell in it.
units.1 Chronicles 17:5: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up until this day; I was in a tent and in a lodging.
units.1 Chronicles 17:6: In all the places through which I passed in all Israel, did I ever speak unto one tribe of Israel appointed to shepherd My people, saying, “You have not built Me a cedar house”?
units.1 Chronicles 17:7: Now say this to My servant David: Thus says the Lord Almighty: I took you from the sheepfold, from following the flocks, to become leader over My people Israel.
units.1 Chronicles 17:8: I was with you wherever you went and destroyed all your enemies before you; I made you a name like the name of the great ones on the earth.
units.1 Chronicles 17:9: I will appoint a place for My people Israel and plant them, and they shall dwell by themselves and no longer be anxious. Injustice shall no longer humble them as at the beginning.
units.1 Chronicles 17:10: From the days when I appointed judges over My people Israel, I humbled all your enemies. I will increase you, and the Lord will build you a house.
units.1 Thessalonians 1:1: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the Church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: grace to you and peace.
units.1 Thessalonians 1:2: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers, unceasingly
units.1 Thessalonians 1:3: remembering your work of faith and labor of love and endurance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ before our God and Father,
